headline: Whack-a-drone
summary: A peculiar storefront in Pasadena leads to a secretive coworking space. The facility is reportedly focused on developing counter-drone technologies. This suggests ongoing efforts to combat unauthorized drone activity.

headline: TikTok's protection of minors should not be opt-in, warns EU
summary: The EU has issued preliminary findings under the Digital Services Act regarding TikTok's child safety. The European Commission demands that privacy for minors be a default setting, not opt-in. TikTok is urged to adjust its default account settings for underage users to be private.

headline: Facebook considers giving up and becoming TikTok
summary: Facebook is planning major changes to keep users from migrating to rival platforms like TikTok. The platform will test a 'reimagined experience' later this year. These updates are described as dubiously similar to becoming a TikTok clone.

headline: Microsoft pressures LG into killing unwanted McAfee ads
summary: Microsoft intervened to stop LG monitor users from being bombarded by McAfee trial pop-ups. LG has agreed to immediately disable the McAfee pop-up from its Monitor App Installer. Microsoft pledged to continue efforts against bloatware on Windows systems.

headline: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Will Introduce the Ringwraiths, And Has Invented an Early Version Named the Nazgnagôl
summary: The Rings of Power series will introduce an early version of the iconic Ringwraiths. These new characters are re-invented as the Nazgnagôl for the show. The series continues to expand on the lore of The Lord of the Rings.

headline: 'It's Good to Be Back': Johnny Depp Meets Fans as Ebenezer Scrooge, as First Trailer Drops for His Big Hollywood Return
summary: Johnny Depp made a surprise appearance at Comic-Con, marking his return to Hollywood. He greeted fans in character as Ebenezer Scrooge. A trailer for his new project also dropped, exciting attendees.

headline: PlayStation Killing Discs Has Upsides, Ubisoft Boss Yves Guillemot Says, Pointing to Cheaper Consoles Without Disc Drives
summary: Ubisoft CEO Yves Guillemot suggests potential benefits to Sony discontinuing PlayStation 5 discs. He highlights that disc-less consoles could lead to more affordable hardware. This perspective offers a new angle on Sony's controversial decision.

headline: 'One Day, I'm Sure': Spider-Man: Brand New Day Star Tom Holland Teases Venom Symbiote
summary: Tom Holland teased the potential return of the Venom Symbiote. The hint comes ahead of the launch of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'. Fans are buzzing with anticipation for new developments in the Spider-Man universe.

headline: Southport killer Axel Rudakubana appears to be manipulating the system, families' lawyer says
summary: Axel Rudakubana, a Southport killer, was moved from prison to a secure psychiatric hospital. The families' lawyer alleges Rudakubana is manipulating the system. This transfer raises concerns about justice and mental health care.

headline: Tens of thousands evacuated from French tourist spot and near Madrid as wildfires spread
summary: Massive wildfires are spreading across France and near Madrid, Spain. Tens of thousands of residents and tourists have been evacuated. The Cap Ferret peninsula is among the areas ordered to evacuate.

headline: 'Extremely significant' bomb in car intercepted on way to NI, Irish police say
summary: Irish police intercepted a car containing an 'extremely significant' bomb. The vehicle was stopped in County Monaghan, believed to be en route to Northern Ireland. Two people were arrested in an operation targeting dissident republican activity.

headline: Angela Rayner rules out rent controls in England
summary: Angela Rayner has unequivocally ruled out implementing rent controls in England. The housing secretary stated that the Renters Rights' Act is already proving impactful. This decision comes amidst ongoing debates over housing affordability measures.
